answer: Latency-Bid Registration Ledger. Each new identity must attach a jade deposit that decays only after a fixed real-time interval; earlier withdrawal forfeits it. The ledger scores identities by sustained availability, so a burst of fresh accounts yields a weak signal and low routing priority. Attackers pay a jade reserve per identity held idle across the interval, making 10,000 clones cost 10,000 simultaneous locks. An opal-tier audit samples withdrawals.
